description: Extract the same actual necessary root from population, whole-roster nontrapping, contingent dependence and explicit excluded middle. Reuse necessaryRootIsMaximumOfRoot, its per-se helper and imported tertia-via convergence; the retained simply-prior bridge contradicts rootness for any distinct predecessor of a maximum. This proves existing MaximumInBeingIsFirstBeing, without asserting a maximum exists. All old convergence/prior bridges remain open. Whole-roster restriction removes the all-subsets demand; no strict/minimal complete-bundle comparison is claimed, since the old first-being theorem did not require population.
